mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve immediately.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when HOUST shows a 3-month consecutive increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 9.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profit expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signal a tightening monetary policy in a weak labor market, which typically causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A supply shock, indicated by two consecutive months of industrial production growth below 0.5%, typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate production costs rise and profit margins compress.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL shows a month-over-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales growth (RSAFS) below 0.2% month-over-month signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of periods when RSAFS growth < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 0.3% month-over-month and the federal funds rate remains below 0.5%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy stance in an inflationary environment, typically leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations are supported.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL growth > 0.3% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market recovery, indicated by two consecutive months of nonfarm payrolls growth above 100k, typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as stronger employment supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100k for two consecutive months.
